subject: Aligning on GridPay deep-dive slot & throughput inputs
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@gridpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: GridPay discovery — recap & sizing next steps

Hi Jorge,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — good conversation and helpful context on the fraud-detection flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive focused on dedicated capacity sizing (throughput/latency):

Summary from discovery:
- Primary inference path: real-time transaction scoring + occasional batch re-scores (~10% of traffic).
- 99th pct latency target: 150ms for scoring endpoint; typical payloads ~600 tokens (vector + metadata).
- Expected steady-state Q1 traffic: ~1.5k TPS scoring calls during peak windows; burst capacity could hit 4k TPS.
- Data residency: us-west region, HIPAA not applicable but strong audit requirements.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 90-minute sizing deep-dive with our infra + runtime team to validate throughput assumptions and map to Dedicated pool sizing.
2) Please share any existing load profiles or telemetry (sample traces, p95/p99 latency) — we can ingest these before the call.
3) I'll attach a short Redwood Sizing Checklist to help collect inputs ahead of the meeting.

Availability windows (PDT):
- Tue Oct 6, 9:00–12:00
- Wed Oct 7, 10:00–14:00
- Thu Oct 8, 13:00–16:00

If none of those work, send 2–3 alternatives and Marcus or Naomi will coordinate from our side.

Attached: redwood-sizing-checklist.pdf (short form to populate), sample calendar when we confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

-----Original Message-----
On Mon, Sep 28, 2026 at 13:00 Jorge Alvarez <jorge@gridpay.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the intro call, Irene. We covered a lot — happy to share some of the telemetry you asked for.
>
> — Jorge
From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@gridpay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: GridPay Platform Team <ops@gridpay.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GridPay discovery — recap & sizing next steps

Irene,

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our internal takeaways. Quick answers and notes:

1) Availability: Oct 6 morning (9–11 PDT) looks good for our infra leads. Oct 7 we have a board review, so prefer Oct 6.

2) Telemetry: attaching a trimmed load profile and a small p99 latency extract (gridpay-kpi-sheet.xlsx). The numbers are from last month’s peak window.

3) A couple of clarifications:
- The 600-token average is accurate for the scoring payload, but note that additional metadata can push some calls to ~1k tokens (rare).
- We use a mix of small real-time requests and larger batch jobs that run hourly; both need to be covered in the sizing exercise.

If Oct 6 works, can we do 90 minutes and include Marcus from runtime engineering? Please send a calendar invite and we’ll accept.

Thanks,
Jorge Alvarez
Head of Platform Engineering | GridPay
jorge@gridpay.com | +1 (510) 555-9922

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@gridpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming Oct 6 deep-dive + pre-call ask

Hi Jorge — great, Oct 6 at 09:30 PDT works on our side for a 90-minute deep-dive. I’ve penciled the block and attached the calendar invite (gridpay-deepdive.ics). Marcus, Naomi and I will join; Marcus will own the runtime sizing portion.

Pre-call requests (brief):
- Can you paste a short sample of a scoring request (sanitized) and an example batch job size? This helps us validate prefix caching and KV cache impact.
- If you have any throttling rules or downstream DB latency constraints to share, please include them.

I’ve attached the Redwood Sizing Checklist and our recommended data points. Filling the checklist ahead of the call will reduce prep churn — even a partial sketch is helpful.

Attachments: redwood-sizing-checklist.pdf; gridpay-kpi-sheet.xlsx (from your note); gridpay-deepdive.ics (calendar).

Related links: HubSpot record HS-987654321; shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-gridpay-deepdive

If anything changes, flag here and we’ll adapt. See you Oct 6.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
